components.name: Stainless Steel Vessel (Tank)

components.name: Heat Exchange Jacket or Coil

components.name: Sampling Port and Valves Assembly
components.reasoning: Procured as an integrated assembly allowing sterile sampling and media addition, distinct from the vessel itself.

components.name: Sensors (pH, DO, Temperature Probes)
components.reasoning: Separate electronic/mechanical components inserted into the vessel to monitor key parameters, commonly purchased individually for calibration and replacement.

components.name: Sterile Ports and Connectors (Sanitary Fittings)
